venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 10/30 (MOD MKZ/JK; entered by Mya; posted 3:09am 10/31).** Net $7,463 vs $6,934 target (+8%). Food $711. Comps $52.25. 248 guests, $30.34 avg. Halloween Eve; guests in costume, Jamie DJ'd a festive mood. Calm night — many waiting for Saturday. Fully staffed behind bar; reminders on garnish SOP (mint sprigs in ice water), super martini batches back to freezers. Kitchen closed at 12am due to staffing; small pop around 12. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 10/30 (MOD/Chef KE, JMS; entered by BT; posted 3:56am 10/31).** Net $9,942 vs $11,745 target (-15%). Food $353. Comps $73.60 (0.74%). 327 guests, $30.40 avg. Somewhat chill Friday, slow until ~9pm; a 20-top birthday party in costume (~$1,000+ of sales). Decent pop at 1am (partly from Charmers closing); later last call to accommodate. Many guests in costume ahead of Halloween. 86: Ponies. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 10/30 (AM Maggie & Josh; PM Carey & Lucas; entered by Carey; posted 3:44am 10/31).** Net incl. events $14,905.53; no target entered (reported 'X'). DC/AM $1,236.04, D&C PM $13,669.49, Garden/6A $3,323.21. Food $2,701. No events. Comps $610.70 (4.10%). 314 guests (Tock), $47.47 avg net/guest. Busy Friday; drag show in the Garden hosted by Lucas & Dom was a hit, lots of costumes. Syrups all in stock (miso sesame, toasted marshmallow). Kitchen steady. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 10/30 (MOD/Chef Kyler/Steves; entered by Sean; posted 3:27am 10/31).** Net $8,523 vs $7,796 target (+9%). Food $799, Beverage $6,779. Comps $188.46 (investors/members, gifts). 242 guests (SevenRooms), $35 avg. Perfect Friday, full nearly all night, ~12-party waitlist mostly seated. Top sellers: Rosalie, Burner Phone, King Mambo. 3 no-shows (charged). Glassware: 1 DOF, 1 flute, Campari cheater. Menu count 17/17.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 10/30 (MOD Gigi + Julian + Joe/Josh + Angel + Saleh; entered by Joe; posted 6:18am 10/31).** Net $11,556 vs $11,237 target (+3%). Food $2,065. Standing Room $3,436; Marquee $8,120. Comps $274 (birthdays, anniversaries, investors, DNL). 324 guests, $80.82 avg. Steady but sleepier than normal Friday; busiest 8-10pm with waitlist, quiet from 11pm as Standing Room cleared. Enoch trained on the floor. Maintenance: pebble ice machine down, repair in AM. 86 oysters. No-shows charged. Great costumes.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 10/30 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; form date typed 10/31, posted 3:09am 10/31).** Net incl. events $13,709.87 vs $8,702 target (+58%). Marquee bar $7,309.94; Event sales $8,184 (DASH private event in garden buyout). Food: service $596.50 + event $1,450 = $2,046.50. Comps $1,376.66 total (event $1,196; wrong item $81; gift $10; DNL $19). 213 guests (127 walk-in / 86 reso incl. 25 event), $64.36 avg net/guest (reported GCA $71.41). Lighter Friday on regular service, down a host/barback/server. Event went great. Maintenance: curtain.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 10/30 (AM Sam & Lex/Marcus; PM Justin & Shannon; entered by Alexis; posted 1:43am 10/31).** Net $15,330 vs $14,599 target (+5%). Municipal AM $3,109, PM $9,952, Sun Club $375, Hot Eye $1,822. Food $6,036. Comps $506. 368 guests (OpenTable 108 AM + 260 PM), $41.66 avg. Slow start, filled at 2pm through happy hour; normal Friday after 7:30. Hot Eye very quiet; a guest fell and was attended to by EMS (incident reported). Penultimate day of Sun Club. 86 caviar.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Friday 10/30 (MOD Curtis Hayes; posted 4:08am 10/31).** Net $9,409 vs $11,596 target (-19%). Food $1,430. Comps $312.02 (3.1%; $108 DNL, $70 spillage). 93 resos, 231 guests, $42.96 avg guest spend. Rain stunted walk-ins and waitlist; serious lull around 9pm, pre-gaming for Halloween hurt sales. Floor ran two 30-min breaks, early cuts. No-shows charged. No incidents.
